**Midtklyngen** is a healthcare cluster (*sundhedsklynge*) operating within [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] in Denmark. It is one of the regional units evaluated in the "Atrial Fibrillation in Denmark" (AFDK 2024) annual quality report published by the Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (RKKP). The cluster's performance is systematically tracked across multiple clinical quality indicators related to the diagnosis, treatment, and monitoring of [[atrieflimren]].

Midtklyngen consistently meets or is evaluated against national standards for atrial fibrillation care. For Indicator 1, which measures the timely initiation of anticoagulation therapy, the cluster achieved a result of 92.9%, successfully meeting the standard [^src1]. It also fulfills the standard for [[indikator-4b|Indikator 4b]] (annual P-creatinine measurement for patients on DOAC treatment) within Region Midtjylland [^src4]. Furthermore, the cluster's data contributes to national geographic mapping of ischemic stroke incidence ([[indikator-5|Indikator 5]]) [^src4].

A particularly significant finding in the 2024 report concerns [[indikator-8|Indikator 8]], which measures the proportion of newly diagnosed patients receiving structured patient education within the first year. Midtklyngen stands out as the only unit where patients meet the national standard, achieving a compliance rate of 58% [^src5]. The cluster is also monitored for other critical outcomes, including severe bleeding (Indicator 11) and heart failure (Indicator 15) [^src7], as well as mortality and varying treatment coverage over 1, 2, and 5 years (Indicators 4a1, 4a2, 4a3) [^src2] [^src3] [^src8].
